prompt: Among movies released in 2014 with an IMDb rating of at least 7.5, find the 5 titles that have the most comments in sample_mflix. For each, return: title, year, imdb_rating, comment_count, and the email of the most recent commenter on that movie (by comment date descending). Sort the 5 rows by comment_count descending, then title ascending.
reference: Must join movies to comments, filter year=2014 and imdb.rating>=7.5, compute comment_count, pick latest commenter email per movie, return exactly those fields, limit 5, sorted by comment_count desc then title asc.
